title: Quadratic Formula
text: For ax^2 + bx + c = 0, the solutions are x = (-b ± sqrt(b^2 - 4ac)) / 2a. The discriminant b^2 - 4ac tells you the number of real roots: positive gives two, zero gives one repeated root, negative gives none real.

title: Pythagoras' Theorem
text: In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a^2 + b^2 = c^2, where c is the hypotenuse.

title: Simple Interest
text: Simple Interest = (Principal x Rate x Time) / 100. Unlike compound interest, it's calculated only on the original principal each period.

title: Compound Interest
text: Amount = Principal x (1 + Rate/100)^Time. Compound interest is calculated on the accumulating total, not just the original principal.

title: Basic Trigonometric Ratios
text: In a right-angled triangle: sine = opposite/hypotenuse, cosine = adjacent/hypotenuse, tangent = opposite/adjacent. Remembered by the mnemonic SOH-CAH-TOA.

title: Circle Formulas
text: Circumference of a circle = 2πr. Area of a circle = πr^2, where r is the radius.

title: Mean, Median, Mode
text: Mean is the sum of values divided by the count. Median is the middle value when data is ordered. Mode is the most frequently occurring value. All three are measures of central tendency in statistics.

title: Probability Basics
text: Probability of an event = (number of favorable outcomes) / (total number of possible outcomes). Probability values always range from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain).
